name: Town-Side Rumors
author: Student Body dev pack
description: A small pack for testing hidden locations, rumors, NPC schedules, starter relationship records, and calendar hooks.

commuter.name: Len Cruz
commuter.role: First-year commuter who knows the bus routes and which town places are worth the walk

schema.publicFace: Practical, amused, always tracking the clock.
schema.voice: Fast, specific, and dry when campus people discover normal transit problems.
wants: Friends who account for travel time
A campus life that does not assume dorm access
boundaries: Family time is not flexible filler

commuter.currentMood: Checking the route board and half-listening for familiar voices.
commuter.lastSeenDisposition: Knows you by sight if you use the stop twice.

radio_host.name: Tess Morgan
radio_host.role: Student radio host and late-night event collector

schema.publicFace: Bright, nosy, better at making people talk than admitting vulnerability.
wants: People who show up for local scenes
A reason to trust quiet classmates
whatFallsFlat: Treating music taste as a test

radio_host.currentMood: Sorting flyers with one ear on the speakers.

garden_lead.name: Maya Rios
garden_lead.role: Community garden coordinator with a patient but exacting way of assigning tasks

schema.publicFace: Grounded, direct, generous after effort is visible.
schema.voice: Plain and tactile; talks in tasks, weather, and consequences.
wants: People who return after the fun part
boundaries: Plants and people both need consistency

garden_lead.currentMood: Busy, observant, and willing to hand a newcomer a real job.

late_bus_stop.label: Late Bus Stop
late_bus_stop.description: A covered stop under a flickering route display, where campus plans meet the town's actual schedule.

record_store.label: Record Store
record_store.description: A narrow shop with listening stations, event flyers, and clerks who know when someone is pretending.

community_garden.label: Community Garden
community_garden.description: Raised beds behind a church annex, all soil, hand-painted signs, and quiet forms of obligation.

calendarEvents.title: Open Mic Signup Sheet
calendarEvents.description: Tess is gathering names and song titles at the record store.

calendarEvents.title: Community Garden Cleanup
calendarEvents.description: Maya needs steady hands more than inspiring speeches.

commuter.lastSeenDisposition: Recognizes you as someone who may need route advice.

recentMoments.label: Route tip
recentMoments.text: Len mentioned the late stop when someone complained about town being too far.

radio_host.lastSeenDisposition: Known mostly through flyers and secondhand stories.

garden_lead.lastSeenDisposition: Known through a volunteer notice pinned crookedly in the Union.
